name: Banca Generali S.p.A.
summary: Banca Generali S.p.A. distributes financial products and services for high net worth, affluent and private customers through financial advisors in Italy. The company operates through Private Banking CGU (PB CGU) and Senior Partner CGU (SP CGU) segments.
